title: IAA 2017 - Mercedes AMG Project One and Mercedes Concept EQA World Premiere
description:
At the Mercedes stand on the IAA 2017 you will find a variety of premieres. The portfolio ranges from the Hypercar AMG Project One to the future vision of car sharing with the smartvision EQ fortwo. But Mercedes also presents the S-Class Coupe and the S-Class Convertible as well as the Mercedes Concept EQA. Source: http://quickcarreview.com
